title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E03 — Death of a Baseball Mom
When beloved mother and sister Janora Stevens is found brutally stabbed in her Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, her family is divided and increasingly suspicious of each other; the case chills until a trail of tell-tale fibers leads cops to her killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E17 — Sisters in Death
In 1984, Jack Kennedy discovers his daughters brutally murdered; their mother and niece spend their lives keeping the case alive; thirty years later, an informant gives up a name, but the family's ordeal is far from over.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E18 — One Tough Mother
In July 1997, the brutal murder of 19-year-old Tiffany Johnston rocks the small town of Bethany, Okla.; DNA evidence points to her killer over a decade later and leads to the buried bodies of two other missing women in Texas.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E23 — A Is for Arson
When firefighter Gary Parks is killed in a fire ruled to be arson, the investigation into his death shifts to homicide; a serial arsonist is thought to be the culprit, but it takes a dogged cold-case detective to track down the real killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E04 — Death of a Hero
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo; a closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E05 — The Heartland Killer
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E12 — Damn His Soul to Hell
The 1964 murder of 9-year-old Marise Chiverella leaves the town of Hazleton, Pa., in fear; an intense manhunt yields numerous suspects but no killer; five decades pass before a student moonlighting as a genetic genealogist reignites the case.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E09 — Mapping a Murder
After the gruesome murder of an aspiring actor in Georgia, police quickly run out of leads; a new digital forensic tool breathes life into the investigation, allowing authorities to identify the killer with pinpoint precision.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E02 — Dark Mode
When two teenage classmates in Northern California go missing within weeks of each other, their mothers struggle to get police to take the situation seriously; but then, unusual cell phone activity by a group of potential suspects gets scrutinized.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E04 — Caught in the App
Detectives in Aurora gather crucial information about a double homicide from neighborhood surveillance footage, but they're not able to identify and track the killer until some key digital data is uncovered.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E05 — Tracking a Killer
When a 17-year-old transgender social media influencer in Vancouver, Wash., goes silent, her family and fans fear foul play; digital data allows detectives working on the case to track the movements of their suspect on the morning of the crime.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E01 — Web of Lies
With digital forensics, authorities are able to debunk the alibi of one of the last people to see a 24-year-old missing jogger in rural Arkansas, making him the primary suspect in her murder; first-time interviews with the victim's family.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E03 — Digital Obsession
Investigators trying to determine who shot and killed a young mother in Ohio are tipped off by a surprising piece of digital evidence; from there, they unravel a twisted story of stalking and social media catfishing.

title: The Real SVU
description:
S01 E01 — Murder at Soho House
A successful swimsuit designer is found dead at an exclusive Manhattan hotel, with all signs pointing to her trust-fund boyfriend as the perp; the SVU team is shocked at what it uncovers about the suspect's dark family history.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E08 — Who Murdered the Postman?
After a U.S. postal employee is shot dead in his truck, detectives push their prime suspect to admit it wasn't just a tragic accident.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E18 — Victim or Accomplice?
Authorities question a woman who traveled with a serial killer about whether she was a victim or an accomplice; a bone-chilling confession from a man who freely admits to killing a college student.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E06 — Unrequited Love
A woman is murdered by the foster daughter she took in; an open-and-shut case becomes more complicated as evidence emerges that the foster daughter may not have acted alone.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E19 — The Demon Inside
A prolific serial killer's confession in the murder of a young woman turns out to be a hoax, but decades later, a more likely suspect is ready to talk -- under one condition.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E16 — The Cigarette Break
A young man accused of killing a beloved 52-year-old woman changes his tune after a cigarette break; DNA technology helps detectives solve a decades-old murder mystery.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E02 — Tangled Affairs
When a beloved art teacher is murdered in her own home, her husband and a growing list of suspects face tough questions in the interrogation room.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E13 — Stone Cold Murder
After a man gets gunned down outside a local shop, authorities interrogate two of his acquaintances to find out which one of them pulled the trigger; the interrogation of a woman accused of mowing down two children with her car.
